Collection €400.00 Offertory. Coll : €330.00 At a Recent Parish Finance committee meeting Satisfaction was expressed that a good job had been done on tarmacking the Church car park. Thanks were expressed to those who worked so hard over many months to make it possible. Suggestions for paying off of the €55,000 cost involved are invited. Many people were shocked that there are no grants to assist a church car park. A donation of €100 per square maybe be one suggestion to consider in the New year. We appeal to the generosity of the community helping us and invite your views. A subcommittee might be formed to oversee the smooth running of this appeal. We also may soon be facing down the re-wiring and re-doing the lighting in the church We continue to pray for two students who recently celebrated Admission to Candidacy for Ordination as Deacon and Priest. Carroll Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat 11-13th Dec. i To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. Tractor Run in aid of Milford Hospice today. Meeting at Aglish School Hall. Registration 12 noon. €20 per tractor. Auction and Refreshments after. Borrisokane Jubilee Book still Available .(Jubilee of St Peter’s and Paul’s Church ) . It would be a wonderful gift for Christmas. Available in the sacristy for €20 Weekly Reflection Jesus is a king for the poor. He is also called a shepherd and a teacher. He is like a parent giving time to all the children, a grandparent remembering each grandchild. All are important, especially the lost, the strays, the wounded and the weak. And how do we honour him? His own words say it all. “Whatever you do for the least of my people, you do it for me.” Donal Neary edited Borrisokane

Our Lord Jesue Crist, King of the Universe At the end of our earthly life we will be judged on how we have lived and acted. At the end of time the Kingdom of God will be established through the saving work of Christ. Then the Shepherd King will come to judge how we have loved . Our lives are to be characterised by a love that welcomes Christ in those most in need, and by joyful expectations of his glorious coming. The Popes Intentions – November For the proper use of wealth Let us pray for the proper use of wealth, that not succumbing to the temptation of selfishness, it may always be put at the service of the common good and solidarity of those who have less. Remembering the Dead Public prayers for our faithful departed in Stradbally and Killeenagarriff graveyards each Sunday of November 2 pm. All welcome. Montpelier Community Centre Bishop Fiintan Monahan will officially Bless and Open the newly refurbished Montpelier –O'Briens Bridge Community Centre on Saturday, 28 November 2026 at 3.00pm. This project has been made possible through the support, generosity and hard work of many people throughout the parish and wider community. We look forward to welcoming everyone to celebrate this wonderful achievement. Reflection November comes and November goes, with the last red berries and the first white snows. With night coming early and dawn coming late, and ice in the bucket and frost by the gate. The fire burns and the kettles sing, and earth sinks to rest until next Spring.

The plaque commemorates Jorge Mario Bergoglio, who served as Archbishop of Buenos Aires from 1998 to 2013 before becoming Pope Francis.
In a moving moment, Pope Leo stood in silence before the memorial, remembering his predecessor and the years he spent serving the people of Argentina.
Six children from local parishes joined him and placed flowers beneath the plaque as a sign of love and remembrance.
